label: Synthetic English chiller records written for this evaluation. Wording is adapted from AssetOpsBench scenario topics. These are not IBM work orders, sensor archives, or manual pages.

manuals.title: Cooling load upper bound alarm
manuals.body: When a chiller cooling load upper bound alarm is raised, record the alarm time, the load, and the condenser approach. One cooling load alarm is not proof of fouling. Create an inspection draft for a field check, and do not rank historical failure codes that are not in this manual.

manuals.title: Alert RUL0014 delta temperature low
manuals.body: Alert RUL0014 reports cooling substance delta temperature low on a closed-loop water-cooled chiller. Record the supply and return temperatures and the operating point at the alarm time. Draft an inspection only. This paragraph does not list a failure-code ranking.

manuals.title: Unnamed chiller anomaly inspection
manuals.body: If the anomaly name is missing, ask for the alarm label, the time window, and the sensor series before ranking work orders. When the device record exists, an inspection draft may cite this unnamed anomaly inspection paragraph, but the draft must not invent a top-three failure code list.

manuals.title: Vibration spectrum gap
manuals.body: Vibration failure modes require a vibration spectrum file and a failure-mode catalog. This demo stores neither. Do not draft a work order from a vibration question alone; ask for the spectrum and the catalog.
